explanation_full: The incremental feature analysis demonstrates how the model's performance changes as features are added sequentially. For KNN, the R² score increases steadily, reaching a peak of 0.8301 at 9 features (VFA -> ... -> pH -> ORP_Low). The Mean Squared Error (MSE) also decreases, reaching a minimum of 0.0119 at this same point. The overall best model performance, based on the summary text, is achieved by KNN (R²=0.8172, MSE=0.0128) and RF (R²=0.7756, MSE=0.0157) when considering the full set of features. This suggests that the model benefits significantly from the inclusion of multiple features, with KNN showing the highest predictive power in this analysis.
